snippet.title: Now Showing:   |    Trailer
snippet.description:
You need a job.
The Mask Theater needs a Projector Operator.

The work is simple.
Thread the film in the correct order. Keep the reels fed before the projector runs dry. Too much slack… and something notices.

There’s just one problem.

From the booth, you can see the audience. Some of them aren’t human... almost perfect imitations with backward-bent necks and wrong-facing knees. They don’t blink. They don’t leave. And they’re watching you.

You have tools. Comedy and tragedy masks, renowned for what the theater is known for... but they adapt.

Be an outstanding employee. Don’t disappoint your boss.

He’s hiding something.
And somewhere in the small town, a masked killer wears the same face you do...

Game available here: https://deogen-games.itch.io/now-showing
